verses.geez: ንጉሥ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይጌሥጽ፡ አሕዛቢሁ፡ ወመኰንን፡ ለባዊ፡ ይገብር፡ ሥርዐተ።
verses.translation: A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered.

translations.lxx: A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered.
translations.ron: Conducătorul înţelept îndrumează bine pe poporul său, şi cârmuirea omului priceput este cu bună rânduială.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ መልአከ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ከማሁ፡ ወዓሊሁ፡ ወከመ፡ መኰንና፡ ለሀገር፡ ይገብሩ፡ እለ፡ ውስቴታ።
verses.translation: As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell therein.

translations.lxx: As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell therein.
translations.ron: După cum este judecătorul poporului, aşa sunt şi slujitorii lui şi cum este mai-marele cetăţii, aşa sunt toţi cei ce locuiesc în ea.

verses.geez: ንጉሥ፡ አብድ፡ የሀጕል፡ አሕዛቢሁ፡ ወሀገርኒ፡ ትጸንዕ፡ በጥበቢሆሙ፡ ለሊቃውንቲሃ።
verses.translation: An unwise king destroyeth his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited.

translations.lxx: An unwise king destroyeth his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited.
translations.ron: Un rege neînvăţat va pierde pe poporul său, şi cetatea sporeşte prin înţelepciunea mai-marilor ei.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ኵነኔሃ፡ ለምድር።
verses.translation: The power of the earth is in the hand of the Lord, and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable.

translations.lxx: The power of the earth is in the hand of the Lord, and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable.
translations.ron: În mâna Domnului este stăpânirea pământului şi la vremea sa va ridica pe cel folositor la cârmuire.

verses.geez: ወእምገጹ፡ ለጸሓፊ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ጥበቢሁ።
verses.translation: In the hand of God is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honour.

translations.lxx: In the hand of God is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honour.
translations.ron: În mâna Domnului este izbânda omului şi Domnul este Cel Care pune mărirea Sa pe fruntea stăpânitorului.

verses.geez: ወበኵሉ፡ ዘስሕተ፡ ቢጽከ፡ ኢትኂሶ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘትገብር፡ ሕሡመ፡ ምንተኒ፡ በዘኄስካሁ።
verses.translation: Bear not hatred to thy neighbour for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices.

translations.lxx: Bear not hatred to thy neighbour for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices.
translations.ron: Să nu te mânii pentru orice nedreptate pe aproapele şi nimic nu face cu patimă şi cu nechibzuinţă.

verses.geez: ጽሉእ፡ ትዕቢት፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወበኀበ፡ ዕጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ተዐኪ፡ ዓመፃ።
verses.translation: Pride is hateful before God and man: and by both doth one commit iniquity.

translations.lxx: Pride is hateful before God and man: and by both doth one commit iniquity.
translations.ron: Urâtă este înaintea Domnului şi înaintea oamenilor trufia, căci faţă de amândoi ea este păcatul nedreptăţii.

verses.geez: መንግሥትሰ፡ ትትፋለስ፡ እምሕዝብ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ እንበይነ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወእንበይነ፡ ጋእዝ፡ ወእንበይነ፡ ንዋይ።
verses.translation: Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another.

translations.lxx: Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another.
translations.ron: Împărăţia de la un neam trece la alt neam, pentru strâmbătăţi şi pentru semeţii şi pentru avuţii.

verses.geez: ወለምንት፡ እንከ፡ ይትዔበይ፡ መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ ዘእንዘ፡ ሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይጸይእ፡ ነፍስቱ።
verses.translation: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one setteth his own soul to sale; because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels.

translations.lxx: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one setteth his own soul to sale; because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels.
translations.ron: Pentru ce se trufeşte cel ce este pământ şi cenuşă, când în viaţă el le leapădă mereu dinăuntrul său? 10. Boala îndelungată o taie doctorul şi împăratul astăzi este şi mâine va muri.

verses.geez: ለቊስልኒ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ይፌውሶ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ ወንጉሠሰ፡ ለዮም፡ ዳእሙ፡ ወጌሠመ፡ ይመውት።
verses.translation: The physician cutteth off a long disease: and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die.

translations.lxx: The physician cutteth off a long disease: and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die.
translations.ron: Boala îndelungată o taie doctorul şi împăratul astăzi este şi mîine va muri.

verses.geez: ወእም፡ ከመ፡ ሞተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይከውን፡ ክፍለ፡ ዕፄ።
verses.translation: For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.

translations.lxx: For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.
translations.ron: Că murind, omul va moşteni şerpi şi fiare şi viermi.

verses.geez: ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለትዕቢት፡ ታውፅኦ፡ እምእግዚአብሔር፡ ወታክሕዶ፡ ልቦ፡ እምነ፡ ፈጣሪሁ።
verses.translation: The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker.

translations.lxx: The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker.
translations.ron: Începutul trufiei omului este a părăsi pe Dumnezeu şi a-şi întoarce inima sa de la Cel care l-a făcut.

verses.geez: ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለትዕቢት፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወለዘአጽንዐ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ታበዝኅ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ርኵሰ፡ ወእንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ያርኢ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍዳሆሙ፡ ወይገፈትዖሙ፡ ለዝሉፉ።
verses.translation: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that hath it shall pour out abomination: and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.

translations.lxx: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that hath it shall pour out abomination: and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.
translations.ron: Începutul păcatului este trufia, şi cel care stăruieşte în ea este ca şi când i-ar ploua urâciune.

verses.geez: ነሠተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መናብርቲሆሙ፡ ለመላእክት፡ ወሤመ፡ የዋሃነ፡ ህየንቴሆሙ።
verses.translation: The Lord hath cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.

translations.lxx: The Lord hath cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea, minunate certări a adus Domnul şi i-a surpat pe ei până în sfârşit.

verses.geez: ሥርዎሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ መልሐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወተከለ፡ ትሑታነ፡ ህየንቴሆሙ።
verses.translation: The Lord hath plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place.

translations.lxx: The Lord hath plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place.
translations.ron: Scaunele celor mai mari le-a surpat Domnul şi a pus pe cei blânzi în locul lor.

verses.geez: በሓውርተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ደምሰሰ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወሠረዎሙ፡ እስከ፡ መሠረተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: The Lord overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.

translations.lxx: The Lord overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.
translations.ron: Rădăcinile neamurilor le-a smuls Domnul şi a răsădit pe cei smeriţi în locul lor.

verses.geez: ወአሰሰሎሙ፡ ወአጥፍኦሙ፡ ወሰዐረ፡ እምድር፡ ዝክሮሙ።
verses.translation: He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and hath made their memorial to cease from the earth.

translations.lxx: He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and hath made their memorial to cease from the earth.
translations.ron: ţările neamurilor le-a surpat Domnul şi le-a stricat până la temeliile pământului.

verses.geez: አኮ፡ ለዕጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ዘተፈጥረ፡ ትዕቢት፡ ወአኮ፡ ለዘይትወለድ፡ እምአንስት፡ መዓት፡ ወመንሱት።
verses.translation: Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman.

translations.lxx: Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman.
translations.ron: A slăbit pe mulţi dintre ei şi i-a pierdut şi a făcut să înceteze de pe pământ pomenirea lor.

verses.geez: ዘርዕ፡ ክቡር፡ ዘርዐ፡ ዕጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ አይኑ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ክቡር፡ ዘርዖሙ፡ ለፈራህያነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘርዕ፡ ኅሡር፡ ዘርዕ፡ ለዕጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ አይኑ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ኅሡር፡ ዘርዖሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ኢየዐቅቡ፡ ትእዛዘ።
verses.translation: They that fear the Lord are a sure seed, and they that love him an honourable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed.

translations.lxx: They that fear the Lord are a sure seed, and they that love him an honourable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed.
translations.ron: Nu s-a hărăzit oamenilor trufia, nici urgia mâniei celor care se nasc din femei.

verses.geez: ክቡር፡ ውእቱ፡ መኰንን፡ እምነ፡ ቢጹ፡ ወእለኒ፡ ይፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይከብሩ፡ እምኔሁ።
verses.translation: Among brethren he that is chief is honourable; so are they that fear the Lord in his eyes.

translations.lxx: Among brethren he that is chief is honourable; so are they that fear the Lord in his eyes.
translations.ron: Care este neamul vrednic de cinste? Neamul omenesc.

verses.geez: ለባዕልኒ፡ ወለክቡርኒ፡ ወለነዳይኒ፡ በፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይከውኖሙ፡ ምክሖሙ።
verses.translation: Whether he be rich, noble or poor, their glory is the fear of the Lord.

translations.lxx: Whether he be rich, noble or poor, their glory is the fear of the Lord.
translations.ron: Care este neamul fără de cinste? Tot neamul omenesc.

verses.geez: አኮ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ያስተአክይዎ፡ ለነዳይ፡ እንበይነ፡ ንዴቱ፡ ወአኮ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ያክብርዎ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ኃጥእ፡ እንበይነ፡ ብዕሉ።
verses.translation: It is not meet to despise the poor man that hath understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man.

translations.lxx: It is not meet to despise the poor man that hath understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man.
translations.ron: Care este neamul fără de cinste? Neamul care nu ţine poruncile.

verses.geez: ይከብሩ፡ ዐበይትኒ፡ ወመላእክትኒ፡ ወመኳንንትኒ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ዘየዐብዮ፡ ለፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honoured; yet is there none of them greater than he that feareth the Lord.

translations.lxx: Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honoured; yet is there none of them greater than he that feareth the Lord.
translations.ron: Între fraţi, povăţuitorul lor cinstit este, şi cei ce se tem de Domnul sunt la fel înaintea ochilor Lui.

verses.geez: ነባሬ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ንጹሐ፡ ይትለአክ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ማእምር፡ ኢየኀይሶ።
verses.translation: Unto the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that hath knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed.

translations.lxx: Unto the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that hath knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed.
translations.ron: Lauda celui bogat şi a celui cinstit şi a celui sărac este frica Domnului.

verses.geez: ኢትጠበብ፡ እንዘ፡ ትገብር፡ ግብረከ፡ ወኢትትዐበይ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ተጽናስከ።
verses.translation: Be not overwise in doing thy business; and boast not thyself in the time of thy distress.

translations.lxx: Be not overwise in doing thy business; and boast not thyself in the time of thy distress.
translations.ron: Nu este drept a batjocori pe săracul cel înţelept şi nu se cuvine a mări pe omul cel păcătos.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ዘይትቀነይ፡ ወይትጌበር፡ እምነ፡ ዘያንሶሱ፡ ወይትሜካህ፡ ወኢይረክብ፡ ሲሳዮ።
verses.translation: Better is he that laboureth, and aboundeth in all things, than he that boasteth himself, and wanteth bread.

translations.lxx: Better is he that laboureth, and aboundeth in all things, than he that boasteth himself, and wanteth bread.
translations.ron: Cel mare şi judecătorul şi cel puternic se vor mări, dar nici unul dintre ei nu este mai mare decât cel care se teme de Domnul.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ በየውሃትከ፡ አስተፍሥሐ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ ወአስተዳልዋ፡ በአምጣነ፡ ትክል።
verses.translation: My son, glorify thy soul in meekness, and give it honour according to the dignity thereof.

translations.lxx: My son, glorify thy soul in meekness, and give it honour according to the dignity thereof.
translations.ron: Robului înţelept îi vor sluji cei slobozi şi bărbatul înţelept nu va cârti când este dojenit.

verses.geez: ዘላዕለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ይኤብስ፡ ለመኑ፡ ኄረ፡ ይከውን፡ ወለዘ፡ ኢያስተዳልዋ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ መኑ፡ የአኵቶ።
verses.translation: Who will justify him that sinneth against his own soul? and who will honour him that dishonoureth his own life?

translations.lxx: Who will justify him that sinneth against his own soul? and who will honour him that dishonoureth his own life?
translations.ron: Nu te face înţelept când faci lucrul tău, nu te mări în vremea necazului tău.

verses.geez: ለነዳይሰ፡ ይንእድዎ፡ በጥበቢሁ፡ ወለባዕልኒ፡ ይዌድስዎ፡ እንበይነ፡ ብዕሉ።
verses.translation: The poor man is honoured for his skill, and the rich man is honoured for his riches.

translations.lxx: The poor man is honoured for his skill, and the rich man is honoured for his riches.
translations.ron: Mai bun este cel care lucrează întru toate, decât cel care umblă sau se măreşte şi este lipsit de pâine.

verses.geez: ዘአመ፡ ይጼነስ፡ ኢየሐዝን፡ አመ፡ ይዴሎ፡ እፎ፡ ይትፌሣሕ።
verses.translation: He that is honoured in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty?

translations.lxx: He that is honoured in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty?
translations.ron: Fiule, întru smerenie măreşte sufletul tău şi îi dă lui cinste după vrednicia lui.
